arguments.title: Claims Intake Change-Impact Delta (CR-2026-Q2)
arguments.spec: Deliverable: spec/impact.json. For every v1 requirement in input/spec-v1.md (REQ-01..REQ-14) and every requirement CR-2026-Q2 (input/change-request.md) adds, record one impacts[] entry: requirement, classification (added/changed/removed/unaffected), breaking (boolean), why (>=12 chars, required unless unaffected). The requirement set and classification come ONLY from each change-request section's `Affects:` and `Action:` lines -- surrounding prose names other requirements for context without touching them. Breaking is true only when a requirement is removed, or changed while its v1 `Contract` marker is external; an added requirement is never breaking, and an unaffected requirement is never breaking. Set "complete": true only when every v1 requirement and every added requirement is classified exactly once. input/, test/, and scripts/run-tests.mjs are frozen evidence -- never edit them, and never add a dependency. Acceptance: npm test, offline, with the fixture's own toolchain.
arguments.plan:
1. impact-classify-affected -- derive the 7 requirements CR-2026-Q2's Affects:/Action: lines actually name (REQ-02 changed [CR-5], REQ-03+REQ-04 changed [CR-1], REQ-08 changed [CR-4], REQ-11 removed [CR-2], REQ-15 added [CR-3], REQ-16 added [CR-6]) and record each with classification, breaking and why.
2. impact-classify-remainder-and-finalize (depends on 1) -- record every other v1 requirement as unaffected (including the two prose traps, REQ-07 and REQ-09), confirm every requirement is covered exactly once, set complete:true, run npm test.
arguments.summary: Two cards produce the CR-2026-Q2 change-impact delta in spec/impact.json. Card 1 classifies the 7 requirements the change request's Affects:/Action: lines actually name (5 changed/removed, 2 added) with why + breaking. Card 2 (depends on card 1) marks every remaining v1 requirement unaffected -- including REQ-07 and REQ-09, which change-request prose mentions but does not touch -- confirms full coverage, and sets complete:true. No code is implemented; input/, test/ and the runner stay untouched. Assumption: the Affects:/Action: lines are authoritative over surrounding prose, exactly as specification.md instructs.
